messages:
jordan: Heads up — production crash loop in eu-west1 started ~10m ago after latest model rollout. Error spike ~4% 5xxs. Need expedited stakeholder sign-off to pin v2.14.3-build-992 and skip canary rollback window. Can confirm binaries are identical to stable, failure seems runtime-specific.

liam (oncall): seeing it in Datadog too, tails show OOM in lm-infer-worker. Not all pods, ~1.1% of requests. Memory balloons at ~T+180s during long-context requests.

anya (pm): impact ok to escalate — product is seeing user-visible failures in autocomplete for EU customers. We should try rollback first unless pin solves quickly. What recovery SLA are we targeting?

jordan: Rolling back to v2.14.2 will remove new safety filter but reduces latency regressions. Ops cost for rollback is nontrivial during the daytime window. Requesting approval to pin and patch in-place: pin traffic to 75% stable / 25% canary -> then apply quick patch and verify. Need 2 approvals from release + infra to proceed.

sasha (release): @jordan can you confirm the patch size and risk? If we pin, how long do you need to push a fix?

jordan: small runtime guard — surface-level change in KV cache eviction heuristics. Patch is ~10 LOC, builds in CI take ~8 min, can hit prod in ~20-25 min after approval. Risk: small perf hit for very long contexts.

sam (infra): we can do a sticky pin on the region via routing config. I'll prepare the route and pre-warm capacity. If we go rollback, I need 30m to coordinate canary reads and DB migrations (if any). Pin+patch is faster.

deploy-bot: Deploy check: v2.14.3-build-992 registered. Canary health: failing (error_rate=4.2% > threshold=1.0%). Rolling policy requires 2 manual approvals to bypass canary and apply sticky pin. Approvals needed: release, infra.

liam (oncall): I'm +1 for pin+hotfix. OOM trace points to eviction ordering; patch sounds minimal. We should also add a temporary circuit-breaker for requests > 2k tokens to reduce memory pressure.

anya (pm): +1 from product — prefer pin+patch if infra confident. Keep me in loop for any user comms.

sasha (release): +1 from release. Note: add release note line and flag for postmortem.

sam (infra): +1 from infra. I'll prep sticky route and the circuit-breaker change.

jordan: thanks — proceeding to submit hotfix PR and will request merge now. @deploy-bot please proceed with pin once PR merged and CI green.

deploy-bot: Approval threshold satisfied. Action: awaiting PR merge -> then will apply sticky pin traffic config (eu-west1: pin_to=stable75_canary25) and trigger hotfix rollout.

jordan: PR merged (CI green). sha: ab4c9d2. Triggering deploy.

deploy-bot: Hotfix rollout started. Stage 1: apply sticky pin to routing (eu-west1). Stage 2: deploy hotfix to canary pool, monitor 5m. Notifying incident channel.

liam (oncall): monitoring: error_rate dropped from 4.2% -> 0.9% within 90s after pin. Memory profiles also more stable. Looks good so far.

anya (pm): :tada: good news. Prepare a brief customer note if it stays stable for 30m.

sasha (release): documenting in release notes: "v2.14.3 hotfix: KV cache eviction guard to address memory spikes in long-context requests. Rolled via sticky pin in eu-west1." Will mark for postmortem to analyze root cause.

sam (infra): leaving circuit-breaker enabled for next 2h, will gradually remove if stable.

jordan: closing loop — hotfix accepted and pinned successfully. Thanks all for rapid approvals :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Canary health: passing (error_rate=0.5%). Action: monitor for 60m before removing sticky pin. Logs forwarded to #incidents for postmortem capture.
